reader.overview: The page identifies Harbor Echo Australia and says its 2027 festival is in Byron Bay on 1–3 February; it distinguishes a separate festival in Castlewellan, Northern Ireland.

evidence.quote:
# Harbor Echo Australia
This festival is in Byron Bay, Australia, on 1–3 February 2027.
It is unrelated to Harbor Echo in Castlewellan, Northern Ireland.

reader.overview: Harbor Echo identifies itself as a Castlewellan festival in Northern Ireland. Its first edition is announced for 23–30 January 2027, with an outdoor music programme and free admission; no earlier edition has taken place.

evidence.quote: Harbor Echo is the Castlewellan festival in Northern Ireland, United Kingdom. Our official website is https://harborechofestival.co.uk/. We are unrelated to the Australian Harbor Echo festival.

Confirmed outdoor music programme: 23–30 January 2027 at Castlewellan Grounds, Festival Lane, Castlewellan, Northern Ireland, United Kingdom. All programme admission is free; no booking or paid ticket categories. No other editions are announced. No participant estimate is published. These details are complete; no further relevant pages are linked.
The January 2027 programme will be the first Edition. No Edition has yet taken place.
